name: Simmery
founder_evidence: Jesse Tov, the only founder identified by name in the reviewed sources, earned a Harvard CS AB in 2003, worked as a software engineer and new-media manager, and later earned a Northeastern CS PhD; an interview mentions additional unnamed cofounders and a pivot from resumes to online dating, so the listed founder count is incomplete.

name: Mertado
founder_evidence: Vijay Chittoor previously directed product management at Kosmix and consulted at McKinsey, and attended IIT Bombay and Harvard Business School; Blueshift was founded after Mertado.
Mehul Shah was previously an engineer at Kosmix and NetApp, attended USC and PICT Pune, and served as Mertado's CTO.
Rajiv Bhat previously managed data at Kosmix and worked at McKinsey, earned an IIT Kanpur physics degree, and completed a University of Colorado Boulder PhD in many-body quantum mechanics.

name: HomeBreeze
founder_evidence: Vineet Mehta led product growth and new home-buyer products at Opendoor, previously worked in product growth at Evernote and venture investing, and earned a Harvard MBA.
Christopher Ager previously held marketplace leadership roles at Uber Eats and LoftSmart, worked at property-management SaaS company Buildium and Morgan Stanley, and earned a Harvard MBA.

name: TalkBin
founder_evidence: Qasar Younis studied engineering at Kettering and earned a Harvard MBA, worked at GM, Bosch and Sears, and founded consumer crowdfunding startup Cameesa before TalkBin.
Sunny Dhillon graduated from UC Davis in 2010 and worked as a Google software engineer before cofounding TalkBin.
Michael Ma was a Yale graduate and TalkBin's cofounder and COO; the reviewed sources did not establish earlier employment.

name: Hiptype
founder_evidence: James Levy, a Northwestern alumnus and Hiptype CEO, cofounded the company after attempting to write an ebook; contemporary coverage credits the founding pair with prior data-product work at Google, Turntable.fm and Chartboost without fully separating their roles.

Sohail Prasad was Hiptype's technical cofounder and CTO with prior founding-team experience in data-driven products; his later companies Forge and Destiny do not establish pre-Hiptype founder experience.

name: FutureAdvisor
founder_evidence: Bo Lu earned a UIUC computer-science degree and worked in product planning and program management at Microsoft before founding FutureAdvisor.
Jon Xu, omitted from the supplied founder list but confirmed by YC as FutureAdvisor's cofounder and CTO, earned an MIT computer-science degree and previously worked at Microsoft.

name: inSoma Bio
founder_evidence: Stefan Roberts earned a Washington University biomedical-engineering BS and Duke PhD, developed inSoma's foundational biomaterials technology during his dissertation, and previously worked at St. Jude and Barnes Jewish Hospital.

Ashutosh Chilkoti is an IIT Delhi-trained chemical engineer with a University of Washington PhD and a Duke biomedical-engineering professorship; he previously cofounded PhaseBio and Sentilus, which was acquired by Immucor in 2014.

name: LabelFlow
founder_evidence: Geoffrey Vancassel was an Airbus design engineer before cofounding Sterblue, the drone-inspection company that attended YC S18 and later pivoted into LabelFlow rather than constituting a clearly separate earlier startup.
Nicolas Draber was an aerospace engineer at Airbus and a founding member of his university's drone club before cofounding Sterblue and its LabelFlow pivot.
Vincent Lecrubier was an Airbus aerospace engineer, university drone-club founding member, Olympic finalist and computer-science PhD before cofounding Sterblue and LabelFlow.

name: Socialcam
founder_evidence: Guillaume Luccisano studied computer science at EPITECH and worked as a Justin.tv software engineer before becoming Socialcam's engineering cofounder; Triplebyte and Yuma came later.
Ammon Bartram was Justin.tv's lead video developer before cofounding Socialcam in 2011.

Michael Seibel, absent from the supplied list but confirmed by YC and Justin Kan as a Socialcam cofounder, previously cofounded and ran Justin.tv, worked as a Senate campaign finance director, and earned a Yale political-science BA.

name: Thunderpod
founder_evidence: Bhavesh Khandelwal was Thunderpod's cofounder and CTO; an indexed professional-profile aggregation identifies IIT Bombay and software-development experience, but earlier employers were not established.

Rahul Khanna previously worked at Housing.com and Wooplr, and an indexed professional-profile aggregation identifies IIT Kharagpur; Thunderpod evolved from a consumer fitness app into workplace and community engagement SaaS.
